summary: This document changes the policy for adding entries to IANA's Secure Shell protocol parameter registries. Previously it was generally IETF Review, with a few needing Standards Action. It is now Expert Review. It updates RFCs 4250, 4716, 4819, and 8308.

eli5.summary: A club made it easier to add new items to its list. Now an expert says yes or no, rather than a big committee vote.
